program_or_activity: Purchased Long Term Services and Supports (PLTSS)
query_text: site:department.va.gov OR site:va.gov PLTSS bills of collection debt receivable recoverable overpayment incorrect amount
query_scope: Search VA and VHA materials for PLTSS incorrect-amount post-payment review findings converted to bills of collection, receivables, debts, recoveries, offsets, or collectible-dollar amounts.
expected_evidence: connection to PLTSS improper and unknown payment estimate
insufficient_result_rule: If results only describe post-payment review or bills-of-collection process without PLTSS-specific recoverable or collectible dollars, keep field closure and scoring blocked.
public_use_rule: Use as a methodology component gate progress source-query row only; not a savings estimate and not a finding of waste.

program_or_activity: Purchased Long Term Services and Supports (PLTSS)
query_text: site:department.va.gov OR site:va.gov PLTSS medical review recoverability category split incorrect amount documentation technical unknown payment
query_scope: Search VA and VHA materials for PLTSS error-category splits that separate recoverable incorrect-amount findings from documentation, timeliness, technical, unknown-payment, and non-recoverable categories.
expected_evidence: connection to bills of collection or collectible overpayments
insufficient_result_rule: If results mix documentation defects, technical errors, timeliness errors, unknown payments, and recoverable overpayments without a PLTSS-specific recoverability split, keep scoring blocked.
public_use_rule: Use as a methodology component gate progress source-query row only; not a savings estimate and not a finding of waste.
